description: Every Sherweb Partner API capability, plus a local SQLite store, offline analytics, and margin/drift/orphan joins no other Sherweb tool has.

env_var.name: SHERWEB_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY
env_var.description: APIM gateway subscription key from cumulus.sherweb.com Security > APIs.

novel_features.name: Margin per customer
novel_features.description: See net margin per customer (what they owe you minus what you owe Sherweb) for any billing month.

novel_features.name: Bill drift
novel_features.description: Diff the latest payable-charges snapshot against the prior sync to flag charges that appeared, vanished, or changed.

novel_features.name: Orphaned subscriptions
novel_features.description: List active subscriptions with zero receivable charges in the latest period — zombie subs you're paying for but not billing on.

novel_features.name: Fleet subscription roll-up
novel_features.description: One table across ALL customers' subscriptions grouped by product/SKU, with total seats and customer counts.

novel_features.name: Seat right-size advisor
novel_features.description: Flag subscriptions where seats paid differ from metered seats used, per customer.

novel_features.name: Amendment cost-delta preview
novel_features.description: Preview the monthly cost change of a seat amendment before committing it, computed from stored pricing.

novel_features.name: Margin trend across closes
novel_features.description: See each customer's margin across the last N monthly closes so profitability slides surface before an account goes negative.

novel_features.name: Subscription churn diff
novel_features.description: Flag subscriptions added, cancelled, or quantity-changed between two syncs across the whole customer book.

novel_features.name: Unbilled platform usage finder
novel_features.description: Flag metered platform usage that has no matching receivable charge - consumption you absorb instead of billing.
